Container.Name: Fluidd
Container.Overview:
Fluidd is a free and open-source Klipper web interface for managing your 3D printers. A single Fluidd instance can connect to several printers running Moonraker.
After install, open the WebUI, click the menu (three dots, top right) and add your printer with its full Moonraker address (e.g. http://192.168.1.50 or http://192.168.1.50:7125).
If Fluidd can't connect, add your Fluidd URL (http://UNRAID-IP:PORT) to cors_domains in the printer's moonraker.conf.
Cameras: since Fluidd does not run on the printer, use the printer's real IP in the camera stream URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.50/webcam/?action=stream), not localhost or a relative path.
Container.Requires: A 3D printer running Klipper + Moonraker, reachable over the network.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port (container port must match PORT)

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal NGINX port (must match WebUI Port container port)
